The Exotic Rose Experience

A symphony of taste and aroma, crafted for those who appreciate the finer things in life.

Fragrant Rose Essence

We source the finest, most fragrant roses to extract the pure essence that gives our drink its signature aroma and flavor. Every sip is a journey through a blooming rose garden.

  • lens Premium Rose Extracts
  • lens Delicate Floral Notes
  • lens Soothing & Refreshing

The Gold Edition Quality

The Gold Edition signifies our commitment to unparalleled quality. Blending real milk goodness with our exotic rose flavor creates a rich, creamy texture that sets the standard.

  • verified Rich, Creamy Milk Base
  • verified Perfectly Balanced Sweetness
  • verified No Artificial Colors
The Heritage

A Royal Legacy Meet Modern Coolness

Our flavor takes inspiration from the ancient, aromatic art of crafting traditional Indian **Rose Sharbat**—the premium cool-down elixir served to royals. We've blended this authentic floral essence with **Amul's modern dairy perfection** to bring you a silky, chilled milk drink that revitalizes you instantly.

spa Ayurveda & Auspicious Rituals

In Ayurveda, roses are celebrated for their natural cooling properties, calming hot tempers, and pacifying *Sadhaka Pitta* (emotions centered around the heart). During Indian festivals, rose water and petals are symbols of love, auspiciousness, and unmatched hospitality.
